principles: Condition score, risk level, inspection coverage, and result confidence are separate outputs.
NOT_TESTED, UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, and NOT_APPLICABLE must never be silently treated as PASS.
A critical risk flag can override presentation of a high condition score.
All numeric weights and thresholds require product, repair-expert, legal, and user-testing calibration.
noDefaultScorePolicy: Until weights and thresholds are approved, implementations may show findings and coverage but must not produce a numeric condition score.
